name: soma
description: SOMA: mobile QA workflows on top of the official appium-mcp server: run manual test cases on a device, triage failures, write bug reports.

remote_server_url.title: Remote Appium server URL (optional)
remote_server_url.description: Leave empty to use local emulators, simulators and devices. Set to a remote Appium/WebDriver endpoint (self-hosted or a device cloud) to run there instead. Only this exact URL is allowed. Must be https:// (plain http:// is allowed only for localhost) and must not contain credentials; put device-cloud keys in the capabilities file instead.

capabilities_file.title: Appium capabilities file (optional)
capabilities_file.description: Path to a capabilities.json with per-platform presets, read by appium-mcp from disk. Put device-cloud credentials here (e.g. bstack:options, sauce:options, LT:Options for TestMu AI, formerly LambdaTest) instead of in the URL or the chat. Only check-setup reads it, after you approve the command, to check that it exists and is valid JSON without printing it; the other skills never open it. Keep it outside the project folder and out of version control.

app_map_dir.title: App map folder (optional)
app_map_dir.description: Leave empty to turn app maps off. Set to a folder where explore-app saves the locators it found per app, and run-manual-test reuses them to skip repeat lookups (Appium only). Maps hold element names and locators, never typed or on-screen user data. Keep the folder out of version control unless your team wants to share it.
